question: Does training across two physical alternatives before four-slot pruning teach a one-sentence grounder language discrimination that transfers?
baseline: Locked simplified v1; previous paired-description study and Waymo fit/calibration recording split reused. All studies are development. FINAL excluded.
source: All 213 fit and 44 held-out naturally captioned same-class Waymo pairs. Strict unambiguous IoU >0.25 per endpoint. Before four-slot pruning, match each endpoint to the highest-IoU unambiguous original PCA proposal in the registered sentence's 256-box bank. Fill two remaining slots from its native four; order by the registered overlap prior, independent of endpoint labels. Both sentences see the exact same four physical boxes, same point sampling, their own priors and native reference branches.
secondary_source: For a label-free paired probe also pool both native four-box nominations with alternating first and second nominations, nonmax IoU 0.35, canonical caption order; keep four unique boxes and score each sentence on exactly those. At deployment use only the native four of one natural sentence.
optimization: Same original 97-parameter final second-round subject affine, original tanh bound, 64 full-batch Adam steps at 0.001, single final iterate. All new heads see exactly the same caption margins and opposing same-class instances. Independent uses the average logistic loss on the two opposite directions. Worst uses max of the two. Assignment uses the log normalization over the true and crossed assignments: softplus(-(m1+m2)). Broken-pair uses the same assignment loss after re-pairing second margins across physical frames within category at approximately similar frozen difficulty. Marginal caption supervision remains correct. Singleton strata keep original links and are counted.
source_calibration: Compute native four-slot switch counts on 160 source holdout original sentences without labels. Joint comparison of independent, worst, assignment, broken_pair: shrink each score edit relative to v1 to the minimum native switch count in this set. For old_mean and old_worst use the same rule within their own pair. Select the greatest scale in [0,1] within the common count. Report native and calibrated versions, actual counts and scales. No target tuning.
evaluation: Source controlled physical pairs and label-free common nominations: retain all pairs in unconditional coverage, report both correct, selection and rescues/harms per held-out recording. Ordinary target: 2792 Waymo-to-Drone plus 2736 Waymo-to-Quad, one natural sentence with deployed four-slot v1 geometry. Evaluate Acc25/50, mIoU, rescue/harm, all records, conditional changes, recordings and direction means. Score after all predictions sealed. No target supervision for features or revisions. No target updates.
predictions: Providing both sides before pruning should increase available source training pairs. A useful assignment correction must improve held-out two-way ranking and deliver a task gain beyond the same-data independent and broken pairing controls, including at comparable source switch rates. Contrast-sum alone cannot imply two individually correct margins. Inspect this failure explicitly. Report recording concentration. A transfer or mechanistic failure rejects this particular formulation; the production model stays locked.
resources: One existing GPU for frozen forwards, a CPU for 97-coefficient fits, no new backbone training. Two planned target directions have eligible source captions. No off-target training or external experts.
